certified_pool_profile.note: 242 Archived items include DL-012 clone batch (140 Moderate) and DL-033 items (16 Moderate). Removing these shifts the Certified pool slightly toward Easy/Moderate-Easy.

learner_pool_risks.impact: Learners cannot prepare for hardest exam tier
CMA exam has ~25% Difficult items; our pool has ~3%
~75% of items cluster at Moderate-Easy/Moderate — poor discrimination

case_study_certification.note: Case difficulty is better calibrated than MCQ. scored_cases.js has the best calibration (fully remediated S530/S537).

combined_pool_estimate.verdict: Even with case studies, the combined pool is severely underweight on Difficult/Very Difficult items. Content expansion, not just relabeling, is required.

certification_bandwidth_assessment.description: The certification pipeline can handle ~200 items per wave (S853 certified 77 in one batch). At that rate, expanding by 1,000 new Difficult/Very Difficult items would require ~5 certification waves.
certification_bandwidth_assessment.recommendation: Prioritize quality over quantity. Target 100-150 high-quality Difficult/Very Difficult items per section (total 600-900) over 3-4 waves.
